connector.name: Routescore
connector.registryDescription: Read-only pre-sign evidence for onchain agents: route quality, MEV exposure, clear/caution verdict.
connector.summary: Hosted at routescore.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.routescore, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer rs_live_... — a Routescore API key, free to mint on any tier at https://www.routescore.io/account. Required for tools/call (check_swap, record retrieval, quotes); discovery (initialize, tools/list) works without a key. Same tiers and quotas as the stdio package.

env.name: ROUTESCORE_API_KEY
env.description: Routescore API key (rs_live_...), free to mint on any tier. check_swap daily quotas are per account (free 100/day, Pro 1,000, Power 10,000); per-minute burst limits are per key. The broader modeled-quote, scenario, manifest, and record-retrieval surface requires Power. Generate one at https://www.routescore.io/account. Shown once.

env.name: ROUTESCORE_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://www.routescore.io). For local development use http://localhost:3000.
